entries.title: The First Night in Miryang
entries.teaser: Three magistrates. Three nights. No answers.
entries.text:
The assignment is written in a trembling hand: three magistrates died on their first night in Miryang. The fourth is due to arrive before dawn.

Your mentor's warning is brief: 'A frightened spirit may look like a monster. Learn what it wants before you decide what it deserves.'

entries.title: The Guard at the Gate
entries.teaser: The guard fears a woman in white.
entries.text:
The guard raises his weapon before you can speak. When he finally lowers it, he points beyond the office: a woman in white, he says, appears among the bamboo whenever the moon rises.

He knows no name. Beneath his fear is something else: the terror of being the next to die.

entries.title: A Voice in the Bamboo
entries.text:
The spirit blocking the path was Arang. Whether you heard her or brought the fight to an end, the silence that follows leaves the same question: what happened to her in the bamboo?

Your report will have to distinguish what you witnessed from what you could not learn.

entries.title: The First Delivery
entries.teaser: The night ends; the record remains.
entries.text:
Dawn reaches the magistrate's office. The new magistrate has survived the night, and your first delivery is complete.

You leave a record of the choice you made in the grove. A reaper can open a path for the dead, but the living must decide what to do with the truth.
